comparisons.peer_topic: Consumer Real Estate Loan Modification Programs
comparisons.peer_summary: The Corporation offers forbearance, trial offers, and permanent modifications to consumer real estate borrowers in financial difficulty. Forbearance suspends payments and freezes aging, while permanent modifications typically extend terms (up to 30 years) and reduce interest rates, with principal forgiveness and deferrals being insignificant in 2024 and 2023.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Bank of America offer similar modification mechanisms including forbearance, trial modifications, and permanent modifications for borrowers in financial difficulty. Both firms utilize a trial period specifically for mortgage/real estate loans: Citi specifies a generally three-month trial period, while BAC specifies a three-to-four-month trial period. A key difference is that BAC explicitly discloses that permanent modifications can include term extensions of up to 30 years, whereas Citi's summary mentions term extensions without specifying the maximum duration. Additionally, Citi highlights its reliance on a third-party subservicer for these programs, while BAC's disclosure focuses on the specific terms (such as frozen aging during forbearance) rather than the servicing agent.

sentences.text: Through this third-party subservicer, Citi seeks to assist residential mortgage borrowers who are experiencing financial difficulty primarily by offering interest rate reductions, principal and/or interest forbearance, term extensions or combinations thereof.

In the U.S., before permanently modifying the contractual payment terms of a mortgage loan, Citi enters into a trial modification with the borrower, generally a three-month period during which the borrower makes monthly payments under the anticipated modified payment terms.
The following modification programs are offered for consumer real estate loans to borrowers experiencing financial difficulties, in addition to borrowers affected by natural disasters.

Trial Offer and Permanent Modifications: Trial offer for modification plans generally consist of the Corporation offering a borrower modified loan terms that reduce their contractual payments temporarily over a three-to-four-month trial period.
In a permanent modification, the borrower's payment terms are typically modified in more than one manner, but generally include a term extension and an interest rate reduction.

comparisons.peer_summary: The firm may modify terms for borrowers in financial difficulty, primarily via term extensions; modified loans were mostly performing, with negligible defaults in 2024 and ~$100 million charged off in 2023 from previously modified loans.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Goldman Sachs disclose that they may modify loan terms for borrowers experiencing financial difficulty using tools such as interest rate reductions, forbearance, and term extensions. However, the scope and outcome data differ significantly. Citi's disclosure is specific to residential mortgages and highlights the enrollment volume in trial programs ($33 million in 2024). In contrast, Goldman Sachs provides aggregate outcomes for all modified loans, noting that modifications were 'primarily in the form of term extensions' and reporting default/charge-off metrics (negligible defaults in 2024 vs. $100 million charged off in 2023), which Citi does not provide.

sentences.text: Through this third-party subservicer, Citi seeks to assist residential mortgage borrowers who are experiencing financial difficulty primarily by offering interest rate reductions, principal and/or interest forbearance, term extensions or combinations thereof.
During the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023, $33 million and $21 million of mortgage loans, respectively, were enrolled in trial programs.
Such modifications may include, among other things, forbearance of interest or principal, payment extensions or interest rate reductions.

• Loan modifications during both 2024 and 2023 were primarily in the form of term extensions. These extensions increased the weighted average term by 19 months for loans modified during 2024 and by 16 months for loans modified during 2023.

• During 2024, loans that defaulted after being modified were not material. During 2023, the firm charged off approximately $100 million of loans that had defaulted after being modified. Substantially all of the remaining modified loans were performing in accordance with the modified contractual terms as of both December 2024 and December 2023.

comparisons.peer_topic: Process and terms of trial modifications
comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm offers trial modifications for residential real estate loans involving a three-month trial payment period under proposed modified terms; during this period, loans continue to age and accrue interest per original contractual terms, and upon completion, the modification is considered permanent.
comparisons.comparison: Citi and JPMorgan Chase both describe a specific process for trial modifications on residential mortgage/real estate loans involving a three-month period. Both disclosures state that during this trial period, the borrower makes payments under proposed modified terms. A distinct difference is the treatment of the loan during the trial: JPMorgan explicitly states that loans in the trial period 'continue to age and accrue interest in accordance with the original contractual terms,' whereas Citi's text states that loans 'continue to age and accrue interest' but does not specify whether interest accrues at the original or modified rate, though it notes the trial is generally three months.

sentences.text: In the U.S., before permanently modifying the contractual payment terms of a mortgage loan, Citi enters into a trial modification with the borrower, generally a three-month period during which the borrower makes monthly payments under the anticipated modified payment terms.
Upon successful completion of the trial period, and the borrower's formal acceptance of the modified terms, Citi and the borrower enter into a permanent modification.

In addition, the Firm offers trial modifications of residential real estate loans, which generally include a three-month trial payment period during which the borrower makes monthly payments under the proposed modified loan terms.
Loans in a trial payment period continue to age and accrue interest in accordance with the original contractual terms.

comparisons.peer_topic: Loan Modification Practices for Distressed Borrowers
comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm may modify loan terms for borrowers experiencing financial difficulties through mechanisms such as interest rate reductions, principal forgiveness, term extensions, and other concessions.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Morgan Stanley disclose that they may modify loan terms for borrowers in financial difficulty using similar mechanisms such as interest rate reductions, principal forgiveness, and term extensions. The primary difference lies in the level of detail and specificity. Citi's disclosure is focused on residential mortgages and details the operational workflow (third-party subservicer, trial periods, enrollment amounts). Morgan Stanley's disclosure is broader, covering 'certain loans' (likely including commercial) and provides specific data on lending commitments ($746 million in 2024) resulting from modified terms, a metric not present in Citi's residential-focused disclosure.
